summary: dellemc.openmanage known issues in Ansible 14: pending 2.19 qualification of ome_smart_fabric_info, SOCKS/proxy limits in diagnostics and license, OS deployment success with outdated date, iDRAC10 PatrolReadRatePercent, SCP revert, same-name uplinks, and read-only volume properties.
questions: Does idrac_license honor proxy settings on import?
Can PatrolReadRatePercent be set on iDRAC10 with Ansible?

answer_card.title: dellemc.openmanage known issues (14.0.0)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `ome_smart_fabric_info`: ansible-core 2.19 qualification pending.
- `idrac_diagnostics`: no HTTP/HTTPS export via SOCKS proxy.
- `idrac_license`: proxy ignored on import; different errors on iDRAC9 vs 10 for bad share names.
- `idrac_os_deployment`: reports success even with an outdated Expose duration.
- `idrac_redfish_storage_controller`: `PatrolReadRatePercent` can't be set on iDRAC10.
- `idrac_server_config_profile`: revert doesn't remove users added after the export.
- `ome_smart_fabric_uplink`: same-name uplink modifies the existing one.
- `redfish_storage_volume`: encryption type and block_io_size are read-only and ignored.
